snippet.title: Warcraft III: Reforged Forsaken Kingdom - Official Gameplay Trailer | BlizzCon 2026
snippet.description: Return to the Last Days of Lordaeron to experience the fall of one great city and play a part in the founding of another. Test your strategic mettle and meet heroes familiar and new across over 30 hours of new campaign content. Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom launches today.
